metadata.title: Clicked like a confused squirrel and Valorant said ‘Here’s your 1 kill, no questions’
metadata.description:
Me: zero clue, just chaos clicking
Enemy: probably rethinking life choices
Valorant: handing out freebies like it’s a holiday
Click if your aim’s as lost as mine!

Tap if you’ve ever got a kill by pure accident!

#valorant #funnygaming #luckykill #gamingfails #shorts
